title: harvester output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the harvester role. See agents/harvester.md Step 7 for the prose contract this mirrors.

kb_captures.description: Durable knowledge this role verified during its run. The engine makes the kb_capture calls; the role only decides. Optional -- omit or send [] to capture nothing.

items.description: One capture. Everything listed under each field is checked by the engine per capture, never by the report schema: a capture that breaks a rule is refused and logged on its own, and the rest of this report stands. See the capture rubric.

type.description: REQUIRED string, one of: knowledge, learning, runbook.

title.description: REQUIRED string, 8 to 160 characters, ASCII only.

summary.description: REQUIRED string, 20 to 500 characters, ASCII only. The lesson in at most 2 sentences, present tense, standing alone as current truth.

trigger.description: REQUIRED string, exactly one of the listed examples: what kind of event produced this lesson. Never "describes the change".

content.description: Optional string, 40 to 2000 characters, ASCII only. Written only when it adds what the summary cannot hold (labelled sections: Context, Symptom, Cause, Rule/Fix, Tried (failed), Evidence). Content that repeats the summary is refused. A failed-attempt capture must have Cause and Rule/Fix. No credentials or token-shaped strings.

source_files.description: REQUIRED array of strings, at least one: files that make this claim checkable. An entry with no basis is rejected, because the freshness sweep can never stale it.

symbols.description: Optional array of strings: symbols this claim is about.

recall_cues.description: Optional array of strings: phrases a future reader would search for to find this lesson.

error_signatures.description: Optional array of strings: exact error strings that this lesson explains.

kb_used.description: Optional. Knowledge bank entries (pushed into your prompt or returned by a query) you actually relied on, and how. Omit or send [] when none. Each item is checked by the engine, never by the report schema: a malformed item is logged and dropped, and the rest of this report stands.

items.description: One entry used: an object {id, how}.

id.description: REQUIRED string: the KB entry id exactly as it was given to you.

how.description: REQUIRED string: one sentence on how the entry shaped your work.

kb_wrong.description: Optional. Knowledge bank entries that proved wrong in practice. The engine forwards each one as KB feedback. Omit or send [] when none. Each item is checked by the engine, never by the report schema: a malformed item is logged and dropped, and the rest of this report stands.

items.description: One wrong entry: an object {id, reason}.

id.description: REQUIRED string: the KB entry id exactly as it was given to you.

reason.description: REQUIRED string: what was wrong, as observed.
